title: Too Much Optimisation
description: Tooo much optimisation to make any potato pc or laptop actual launch minecraft
body: Built for stability and smooth gameplay, this optimisation-focused modpack is designed to enhance Minecraft’s performance without changing the core experience. With carefully selected performance mods, improved loading times, higher FPS, reduced lag, and better memory usage, you can enjoy a cleaner and more responsive game on low-end systems. Perfect for players who want vanilla-style gameplay with maximum efficiency.
